why: The reference concept has a soft floor shadow under the bench and the Tier-1 foreground mask counts it (analysis/reference-suitability.md). Gate renders carry a matching contact shadow (an ambient-occlusion floor decal computed from the model's height above the floor, blurred; no light involved) so the silhouette comparison measures the same thing on both sides; the model's own lighting and key-light self-shadowing are unchanged.
how: Settings chosen by renders/camera-fit/shadow-sweep.json (36 settings on the fixed view, Tier-1 mask vs the reference).
allowHolesWhy: The bench frame encloses real negative spaces (under the top between the legs, stretchers and cross braces; declared in silhouetteAnalysis.negativeSpaces), so turntable views are holed by design.
